### Exchanging Candidates（交换候选）

The initiator and responder negotiate connectivity over ICE by exchanging XML-formatted transport candidates for the channel. This negotiation proceeds immediately in order to maximize the possibility that connectivity can be established (and therefore media can be exchanged) as quickly as possible. In order to expedite session establishment, the initiator SHOULD include transport candidates in its session-initiate message but MAY also send additional transport candidates as soon as it learns of them, even before receiving acknowledgement of the session-initiate message (i.e., the initiator MUST consider the session to be live as soon as it sends the session-initiate message).

发起方和响应方通过交换 XML 格式的通道传输候选，在 ICE 上协商连接性。此协商立即进行，以最大限度地提高尽快建立连接性（从而能够交换媒体）的可能性。为了加快会话建立，发起方应在其 session-initiate 消息中包含传输候选，但也可以在获悉其他传输候选后立即发送它们，甚至在收到 session-initiate 消息的确认之前（即，发起方必须在发送 session-initiate 消息后立即将会话视为活跃状态）。

> Given in-order delivery as mandated by XMPP Core
> RFC 6120: Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol (XMPP): Core <http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6120>.
, the responder will receive such transport-info messages after receiving the session-initiate message; if not, it is appropriate for the responder to return <unknown-session/> errors since according to its state machine the session does not exist.

> 鉴于 XMPP Core (RFC 6120) 要求的有序传递，响应方将在收到 session-initiate 消息之后收到此类 transport-info 消息；如果不是这样，响应方适合返回 <unknown-session/> 错误，因为根据其状态机，该会话不存在。

The first step in negotiating connectivity is for each party to send transport candidates to the other party.
> The fact that both parties send candidates means that Jingle requires each party to be a full implementation of ICE, not a lite implementation as specified in ICE-CORE.
These candidates SHOULD be gathered by following the procedure specified in Section 4.1.1 of ICE-CORE (typically by communicating with a standalone STUN server in order to discover the client's public IP address and port) and prioritized by following the procedure specified in Section 4.1.2 of ICE-CORE.

协商连接性的第一步是各方将传输候选发送给另一方。
> 双方都发送候选这一事实意味着 Jingle 要求每一方都是 ICE 的完整实现，而不是 ICE-CORE 中指定的 lite 实现。
这些候选应按照 ICE-CORE 第 4.1.1 节指定的过程进行收集（通常通过与独立的 STUN 服务器通信以发现客户端的公共 IP 地址和端口），并按照 ICE-CORE 第 4.1.2 节指定的过程进行优先级排序。

Each candidate shall be sent as a <candidate/> child of a <transport/> element qualified by the 'urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1' namespace. The <transport/> element is sent via a Jingle message of type session-initiate, session-accept, or transport-info.

每个候选应作为由 'urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1' 命名空间限定的 <transport/> 元素的 <candidate/> 子元素发送。<transport/> 元素通过 Jingle 消息发送，消息类型为 session-initiate、session-accept 或 transport-info。

Either party MAY include multiple <candidate/> elements in one <transport/> element, especially in the session-initiate and session-accept messages sent at the beginning of the session negotiation. Including multiple candidates in the session-initiate and session-accept messages can help to ensure interoperability with entities that implement the SDP offer/answer model described in RFC 3264
> RFC 3264: An Offer/Answer Model with the Session Description Protocol (SDP) <http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3264>.
; in particular, an entity SHOULD include multiple candidates in its session-initiate or session-accept message if the other party advertises support for the "urn:ietf:rfc:3264" service discovery feature as described in the SDP Offer / Answer Support section of this document. However, including one candidate per subsequent transport-info message typically results in a faster negotiation because the candidates most likely to succeed are sent first (in the session-info and session-accept messages) and it is not necessary to gather all candidates before beginning to send any candidates; furthermore, because certain candidates can be more "expensive" in terms of bandwidth or processing power, either party might not want to advertise the existence of such candidates unless it is necessary to do so after other candidates have failed.

任一方可在一个 <transport/> 元素中包含多个 <candidate/> 元素，特别是在会话协商开始时发送的 session-initiate 和 session-accept 消息中。在 session-initiate 和 session-accept 消息中包含多个候选有助于确保与实现 RFC 3264 中描述的 SDP offer/answer 模型的实体的互操作性；特别是，如果另一方通过广告支持 "urn:ietf:rfc:3264" 服务发现功能（如本文档的 SDP Offer/Answer 支持部分所述），则实体应在其 session-initiate 或 session-accept 消息中包含多个候选。然而，在后续的 transport-info 消息中每条消息包含一个候选通常会带来更快的协商，因为最有可能成功的候选会首先发送（在 session-initiate 和 session-accept 消息中），而且无需在开始发送任何候选之前收集所有候选；此外，由于某些候选在带宽或处理能力方面可能更"昂贵"，任一方可能不希望广告此类候选的存在，除非在其他候选失败后有必要这样做。

If the party that receives a candidate in a Jingle message can successfully process a given candidate or set of candidates, it returns an IQ-result (if not, for example because the candidate data is improperly formatted, it returns an IQ-error). At this point, the receiving entity is only indicating receipt of the candidate or set of candidates, not telling the other party that the candidate will be used.

如果收到 Jingle 消息中候选的一方能够成功处理给定的候选或候选集，它将返回 IQ-result（如果不能，例如由于候选数据格式不正确，则返回 IQ-error）。此时，接收实体仅表示收到候选或候选集，并不告诉另一方该候选将被使用。

The initiator can keep sending candidates (without stopping to receive an acknowledgement of receipt from the responder for each candidate) until it has exhausted its supply of possible or desirable transport candidates. The responder can also keep sending potential candidates, which the initiator will acknowledge.

发起方可以持续发送候选（无需停下来接收响应方对每个候选的接收确认），直到其耗尽所有可能或需要的传输候选。响应方也可以持续发送潜在的候选，发起方将对其进行确认。

### Connectivity Checks（连接性检查）

As the initiator and responder receive candidates, they probe the candidates for connectivity. In performing these connectivity checks, each party SHOULD follow the procedure specified in Section 7 of ICE-CORE. The following business rules apply:
- Each party sends a STUN Binding Request (see RFC 5389
> RFC 5389: Session Traversal Utilities for NAT (STUN) <http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5389>.
) from each local candidate it generated to each remote candidate it received.
- In accordance with ICE-CORE, the STUN Binding Requests MUST include the PRIORITY attribute (computed according to Section 7.1.1.1. of ICE-CORE).
- For the purposes of the Jingle ICE-UDP Transport Method, both parties are full ICE implementations and therefore the controlling role MUST be assumed by the initiator and the controlled role MUST be assumed by the responder.
- The STUN Binding Requests generated by the initiator MAY include the USE-CANDIDATE attribute to indicate that the initiator wishes to cease checks for this component.
- The STUN Binding Requests generated by the initiator MUST include the ICE-CONTROLLING attribute.
- The STUN Binding Requests generated by the responder MUST include the ICE-CONTROLLED attribute.
- The parties MUST use STUN short term credentials to authenticate requests and perform message integrity checks. As in ICE-CORE, the username in the STUN Binding Request is of the form "ufrag-of-peer:ufrag-of-sender" and the password is the value of the 'pwd' attribute provided by the peer.

当发起方和响应方收到候选时，它们会探测候选的连接性。在执行这些连接性检查时，各方应遵循 ICE-CORE 第 7 节中指定的程序。以下业务规则适用：
- 各方从它生成的每个本地候选向它收到的每个远程候选发送一个 STUN 绑定请求（参见 RFC 5389）。
- 根据 ICE-CORE，STUN 绑定请求必须包含 PRIORITY 属性（根据 ICE-CORE 第 7.1.1.1 节计算）。
- 对于 Jingle ICE-UDP 传输方法而言，双方都是完整的 ICE 实现，因此控制方角色必须由发起方承担，受控方角色必须由响应方承担。
- 发起方生成的 STUN 绑定请求可以包含 USE-CANDIDATE 属性，以表明发起方希望停止对该组件的检查。
- 发起方生成的 STUN 绑定请求必须包含 ICE-CONTROLLING 属性。
- 响应方生成的 STUN 绑定请求必须包含 ICE-CONTROLLED 属性。
- 双方必须使用 STUN 短期凭证来认证请求并执行消息完整性检查。与 ICE-CORE 中一样，STUN 绑定请求中的用户名的格式为 "对等方的ufrag:发送方的ufrag"，密码为对等方提供的 'pwd' 属性的值。

> Thus when Romeo sends a STUN Binding Request to Juliet the credentials will be STUN username "9uB6:8hhy" (ufrag provided by Juliet concatenated with ufrag provided by Romeo) and password "YH75Fviy6338Vbrhrlp8Yh" (pwd provided by Juliet) whereas when Juliet sends a STUN Binding Request to Romeo the credentials will be STUN username "8hhy:9uB6" (ufrag provided by Romeo concatenated with ufrag provided by Juliet) and password "asd88fgpdd777uzjYhagZg" (pwd provided by Romeo).

> 因此，当 Romeo 向 Juliet 发送 STUN 绑定请求时，凭证将是 STUN 用户名 "9uB6:8hhy"（由 Juliet 提供的 ufrag 与 Romeo 提供的 ufrag 拼接而成）和密码 "YH75Fviy6338Vbrhrlp8Yh"（由 Juliet 提供的 pwd），而当 Juliet 向 Romeo 发送 STUN 绑定请求时，凭证将是 STUN 用户名 "8hhy:9uB6"（由 Romeo 提供的 ufrag 与 Juliet 提供的 ufrag 拼接而成）和密码 "asd88fgpdd777uzjYhagZg"（由 Romeo 提供的 pwd）。

When it receives a STUN Binding Request, each party MUST return a STUN Binding Response, which indicates either an error case or the success case. As described in Section 7.1.2.2 of ICE-CORE, a connectivity check succeeds if _all_ of the following are true:
- The STUN transaction generated a success response.
- The source IP address and port of the response equals the destination IP address and port to which the Binding Request was sent.
- The destination IP address and port of the response match the source IP address and port from which the Binding Request was sent.

当收到 STUN 绑定请求时，各方必须返回 STUN 绑定响应，该响应指示错误情况或成功情况。如 ICE-CORE 第 7.1.2.2 节所述，如果满足以下_所有_条件，连接性检查成功：
- STUN 事务生成了成功响应。
- 响应的源 IP 地址和端口等于绑定请求发送到的目标 IP 地址和端口。
- 响应的目标 IP 地址和端口与发送绑定请求的源 IP 地址和端口匹配。

For the candidates exchanged in the previous section, the connectivity checks would be as follows (this diagram mirrors the example in ICE-CORE).

对于上一部分中交换的候选，连接性检查将如下所示（此图反映了 ICE-CORE 中的示例）。

```
  ROMEO (controlling)                     JULIET (controlled)
  |                                       |
  | STUN Binding Request                  |
  | from 192.0.2.3:45664                  |
  | to   192.0.2.1:3478                   |
  | USE-CANDIDATE                         |
  |======================================>|
  |                                       |
  | STUN Binding Response                 |
  | from 192.0.2.1:3478                   |
  | to   192.0.2.3:45664                  |
  |<--------------------------------------|
  |                                       |
  | STUN Binding Request                  |
  | from 192.0.2.1:3478                   |
  | to   192.0.2.3:45664                  |
  |<--------------------------------------|
  |                                       |
  | STUN Binding Response                 |
  | from 192.0.2.3:45664                  |
  | to   192.0.2.1:3478                   |
  | map  192.0.2.1:3478                   |
  |======================================>|
  |                                       |
  |======= MEDIA NOW CAN FLOW ===========>|
  |                                       |
```

Note: Here the initiator (controlling agent) is using "aggressive nomination" as described in Section 8.1.1.2 of ICE-CORE and therefore includes the USE-CANDIDATE attribute in the STUN Binding Requests it sends.

注意：在这里，发起方（控制方）使用了 ICE-CORE 第 8.1.1.2 节中描述的"激进出名"，因此在其发送的 STUN 绑定请求中包含了 USE-CANDIDATE 属性。

### Nomination（提名）

If, based on STUN connectivity checks, the parties determine that they will be able to exchange media between a given pair of local candidates and remote candidates (i.e., the pair is "nominated" and ICE processing is "completed"), they can then begin using that candidate pair to exchange media.

如果基于 STUN 连接性检查，双方确定它们能够在给定的本地候选和远程候选对之间交换媒体（即该对被"提名"且 ICE 处理已"完成"），则它们可以开始使用该候选对交换媒体。

Once the parties have connectivity and therefore the initiator has completed ICE as explained in ICE-CORE, the initiator MAY communicate the in-use candidate pair in the signalling channel by sending a transport-info message that contains a <remote-candidate/> element (this maps to the SDP "remote-candidates" attribute as described in Section B.6 of ICE-CORE, i.e., remote candidates are "the actual candidates at R that were selected by the offerer", of which there will be only one at this stage of the ICE-UDP negotiation).

一旦双方建立了连接性并且发起方已按照 ICE-CORE 的解释完成了 ICE，发起方可以通过发送包含 <remote-candidate/> 元素的 transport-info 消息，在信令通道中传达正在使用的候选对（这映射到 SDP 的 "remote-candidates" 属性，如 ICE-CORE 附录 B.6 所述，即远程候选是"在 R 处由 offerer 选择出来的实际候选"，在 ICE-UDP 协商的这个阶段只会有一个）。

```xml
<iq from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    id='z8i4fs4z'
    to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    type='set'>
  <jingle xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'
          action='transport-info'
          initiator='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
          sid='vj3hs98y'>
    <content creator='initiator' name='this-is-the-audio-content'>
      <transport xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1'>
        <remote-candidate component='1'
                          ip='192.0.2.1'
                          port='3478'/>
      </transport>
    </content>
  </jingle>
</iq>
```

(In accordance with Jingle core, the responder will also acknowledge the transport-info message.)

（根据 Jingle 核心规范，响应方也将确认 transport-info 消息。）

In the unlikely event that one of the parties determines that it cannot establish connectivity even after sending and checking lower-priority candidates, it SHOULD terminate the session as described in Jingle (XEP-0166)
> XEP-0166: Jingle <https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-0166.html>.
.

在不太可能发生的情况下，如果一方即使在发送和检查较低优先级的候选之后仍确定无法建立连接性，则应按照 Jingle (XEP-0166) 的描述终止会话。

### Sending Additional Candidates（发送额外候选）

Even after media has begun to flow, either party MAY continue to send additional candidates to the other party (e.g., because the user agent has become aware of a new media proxy or network interface card). Such candidates are shared by sending a transport-info message.

即使在媒体开始流动之后，任一方也可以继续向另一方发送额外的候选（例如，因为用户代理已经发现新的媒体代理或网络接口卡）。此类候选通过发送 transport-info 消息来共享。

```xml
<iq from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    id='a7b3c5d'
    to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    type='set'>
  <jingle xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'
          action='transport-info'
          initiator='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
          sid='vj3hs98y'>
    <content creator='initiator' name='this-is-the-audio-content'>
      <transport xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1'>
        <candidate component='1'
                   foundation='2'
                   generation='0'
                   id='abc123def'
                   ip='192.0.2.7'
                   network='1'
                   port='45664'
                   priority='1694498815'
                   protocol='udp'
                   type='host'/>
      </transport>
    </content>
  </jingle>
</iq>
```

The receiving party MUST acknowledge receipt of the candidate.

接收方必须确认收到该候选。

```xml
<iq from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    id='a7b3c5d'
    to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    type='result'/>
```

The parties would check the newly-offered candidate for connectivity, as described previously. If the parties determine that media can flow over the candidate, they MAY then use the new candidate in subsequent communications.

双方将检查新提供的候选的连接性，如前所述。如果双方确定媒体可以通过该候选流动，则可以在后续通信中使用新的候选。

### ICE Restarts（ICE 重启）

At any time, either party MAY restart the process of ICE negotiation by sending a candidate with a 'generation' value that is greater than the previous generation of candidates; when it does so, it MUST generate new values for the 'pwd' and 'ufrag' attributes, consistent with the definition of an ICE restart in Section 9.1.1.1 of ICE-CORE. As explained in ICE-CORE, typically the ICE negotiation would be restarted to change the media target (e.g., an IP address change for one of the parties) and certain third-party-call-control scenarios.

在任何时候，任一方可以通过发送一个 'generation' 值大于上一代候选的候选来重启 ICE 协商过程；当这样做时，它必须为 'pwd' 和 'ufrag' 属性生成新的值，与 ICE-CORE 第 9.1.1.1 节中 ICE 重启的定义一致。如 ICE-CORE 所解释的，通常 ICE 协商重启是为了更改媒体目标（例如一方的 IP 地址变更）以及某些第三方呼叫控制场景。

```xml
<iq from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    id='r4t5y6u'
    to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    type='set'>
  <jingle xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'
          action='transport-info'
          initiator='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
          sid='vj3hs98y'>
    <content creator='initiator' name='this-is-the-audio-content'>
      <transport xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1'
                 pwd='newPwdValue777'
                 ufrag='newFrag'>
        <candidate component='1'
                   foundation='1'
                   generation='1'
                   id='newCand01'
                   ip='192.0.2.99'
                   network='0'
                   port='45664'
                   priority='2130706431'
                   protocol='udp'
                   type='host'/>
      </transport>
    </content>
  </jingle>
</iq>
```

The recipient then acknowledges receipt.

然后接收方确认收到。

```xml
<iq from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    id='r4t5y6u'
    to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    type='result'/>
```

The parties would then exchange new candidates to renegotiate connectivity and would check the new candidates for connectivity, as described previously. If the parties determine that media can flow over one of the new candidates, they can then use the successful candidate in subsequent communications. However, while ICE is being renegotiated the parties can continue to send media with the existing candidate-in-use.

然后双方将交换新的候选以重新协商连接性，并检查新候选的连接性，如前所述。如果双方确定媒体可以通过其中一个新候选流动，则可以在后续通信中使用成功的候选。然而，在 ICE 重新协商期间，双方可以继续使用现有的在用候选发送媒体。

## Fallback to Raw UDP Transport（回退到原始 UDP 传输）

It can happen that the responder does not support ICE, in which case it can be necessary to fall back to use of the Jingle Raw UDP Transport Method  (XEP-0177)
> XEP-0177: Jingle Raw UDP Transport Method <https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-0177.html>.
. One typical scenario is communication between an ICE-aware Jingle endpoint and a non-ICE-aware SIP endpoint through a Jingle-to-SIP gateway, as follows:
- The Jingle endpoint sends a session-initiate request to the SIP endpoint, specifying a transport method of ICE-UDP.
- Based on capabilities information, the gateway knows that the SIP endpoint does not support ICE, so it enables the endpoints to use its media relay. It does this by:
  - Sending a transport-replace message to the Jingle endpoint on behalf of the SIP endpoint, specifying a transport method of Raw UDP and a candidate whose IP address and port are hosted at the gateway.
  - Sending SIP INVITE to the SIP endpoint on behalf of the Jingle endpoint, specifying an IP address and port at the gateway.

可能出现响应方不支持 ICE 的情况，此时可能需要回退到使用 Jingle 原始 UDP 传输方法 (XEP-0177)。一个典型的场景是通过 Jingle-to-SIP 网关在支持 ICE 的 Jingle 端点和不支持 ICE 的 SIP 端点之间通信，具体如下：
- Jingle 端点向 SIP 端点发送 session-initiate 请求，指定传输方法为 ICE-UDP。
- 基于能力信息，网关知道 SIP 端点不支持 ICE，因此它让端点使用它的媒体中继。它通过以下方式实现：
  - 代表 SIP 端点向 Jingle 端点发送 transport-replace 消息，指定传输方法为原始 UDP，并使用托管在网关上 IP 地址和端口的候选。
  - 代表 Jingle 端点向 SIP 端点发送 SIP INVITE，指定网关上的 IP 地址和端口。

The session flow is as follows.

会话流程如下：

```
  ROMEO                GATEWAY                JULIET
  (Jingle)                                   (SIP)
  |                       |                    |
  |  session-initiate     |                    |
  |  (ICE-UDP)            |                    |
  |---------------------->|                    |
  |                       |                    |
  |  ack                  |                    |
  |<----------------------|                    |
  |                       |                    |
  |  transport-replace    |                    |
  |  (Raw UDP via relay)  |                    |
  |<----------------------|                    |
  |                       |                    |
  |  ack                  |                    |
  |---------------------->|                    |
  |                       |                    |
  |  transport-accept     |                    |
  |---------------------->|                    |
  |                       |                    |
  |  ack                  |                    |
  |<----------------------|                    |
  |                       | SIP INVITE         |
  |                       | (Raw UDP via relay)|
  |                       |------------------->|
  |                       |                    |
  |                       | 200 OK             |
  |                       |<-------------------|
  |                       |                    |
  |               MEDIA SESSION                |
  |<=====================>|<==================>|
  |                       |                    |
  |  session-terminate    |                    |
  |---------------------->|                    |
  |                       |                    |
  |  ack                  | SIP BYE            |
  |<----------------------|------------------->|
  |                       |                    |
  |                       | ack                |
  |                       |<-------------------|
```

The protocol flow is as follows, showing only the stanzas sent between Romeo and the gateway (acting on Juliet's behalf).

协议流程如下，仅显示 Romeo 与网关（代表 Juliet）之间发送的节。

```xml
<iq from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    id='s2i3n1t'
    to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    type='set'>
  <jingle xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'
          action='session-initiate'
          initiator='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
          sid='fallback01'>
    <content creator='initiator' name='audio'>
      <description xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:apps:rtp:1' media='audio'>
        <payload-type id='96' name='speex' clockrate='16000'/>
      </description>
      <transport xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1'
                 pwd='asd88fgpdd777uzjYhagZg'
                 ufrag='8hhy'>
        <candidate component='1'
                   foundation='1'
                   generation='0'
                   id='el0747fg11'
                   ip='192.0.2.3'
                   network='0'
                   port='45664'
                   priority='2130706431'
                   protocol='udp'
                   type='host'/>
      </transport>
    </content>
  </jingle>
</iq>
```

```xml
<iq from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    id='s2i3n1t'
    to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    type='result'/>
```

Immediately the gateway sends a transport-replace message to Romeo, specifying a transport of Raw UDP with a candidate whose IP address and port identify a media relay at the gateway.

网关立即向 Romeo 发送 transport-replace 消息，指定传输为原始 UDP，并使用一个 IP 地址和端口标识网关上的媒体中继的候选。

```xml
<iq from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    id='gwRplc1'
    to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    type='set'>
  <jingle xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'
          action='transport-replace'
          initiator='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
          sid='fallback01'>
    <content creator='initiator' name='audio'>
      <transport xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:raw-udp:1'>
        <candidate component='1'
                   generation='0'
                   id='gwRelay01'
                   ip='203.0.113.5'
                   port='50000'
                   type='relay'/>
      </transport>
    </content>
  </jingle>
</iq>
```

Romeo then acknowledges the transport-replace message and immediately also sends a transport-accept.

然后 Romeo 确认 transport-replace 消息，并立即也发送 transport-accept。

```xml
<iq from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    id='gwRplc1'
    to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    type='result'/>
```

```xml
<iq from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    id='gwAccpt1'
    to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    type='set'>
  <jingle xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'
          action='transport-accept'
          initiator='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
          sid='fallback01'>
    <content creator='initiator' name='audio'>
      <transport xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:raw-udp:1'>
        <candidate component='1'
                   generation='0'
                   id='romeo1'
                   ip='192.0.2.3'
                   port='45664'
                   type='host'/>
      </transport>
    </content>
  </jingle>
</iq>
```

The gateway then acknowledges the acceptance on behalf of Juliet.

然后网关代表 Juliet 确认接受。

```xml
<iq from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    id='gwAccpt1'
    to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    type='result'/>
```

The responder then sends a session-accept through the gateway.

然后响应方通过网关发送 session-accept。

```xml
<iq from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    id='gwSessAc1'
    to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    type='set'>
  <jingle xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'
          action='session-accept'
          initiator='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
          responder='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
          sid='fallback01'>
    <content creator='initiator' name='audio'>
      <description xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:apps:rtp:1' media='audio'>
        <payload-type id='96' name='speex' clockrate='16000'/>
      </description>
      <transport xmlns='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:raw-udp:1'>
        <candidate component='1'
                   generation='0'
                   id='juliet1'
                   ip='203.0.113.5'
                   port='50000'
                   type='relay'/>
      </transport>
    </content>
  </jingle>
</iq>
```

```xml
<iq from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    id='gwSessAc1'
    to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    type='result'/>
```

The endpoints now begin to exchange session media, and can continue the session as long as desired.

端点现在开始交换会话媒体，并且可以根据需要继续会话。

## Service Discovery（服务发现）

### Advertising Support（广告支持）

To advertise its support for the Jingle ICE-UDP Transport Method, when replying to Service Discovery (XEP-0030)
> XEP-0030: Service Discovery <https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-0030.html>.
information requests an entity MUST return URNs for any version of this protocol that the entity supports -- e.g., "urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1" for this version and "urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:0" for the previous version (see Namespace Versioning regarding the possibility of incrementing the version number).

为了广告其对 Jingle ICE-UDP 传输方法的支持，在回复服务发现 (XEP-0030) 信息请求时，实体必须返回该实体支持的任何版本的此协议的 URN——例如，本版本使用 "urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1"，上一版本使用 "urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:0"（关于版本号递增的可能性，请参见命名空间版本控制）。

```xml
<iq from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    id='disco1'
    to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    type='get'>
  <query xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/disco#info'/>
</iq>
```

```xml
<iq from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'
    id='disco1'
    to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    type='result'>
  <query xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/disco#info'>
    <feature var='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'/>
    <feature var='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1'/>
    <feature var='urn:xmpp:jingle:apps:rtp:1'/>
  </query>
</iq>
```

In order for an application to determine whether an entity supports this protocol, where possible it SHOULD use the dynamic, presence-based profile of service discovery defined in Entity Capabilities (XEP-0115)
> XEP-0115: Entity Capabilities <https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-0115.html>.
. However, if an application has not received entity capabilities information from an entity, it SHOULD use explicit service discovery instead.

为了让应用程序确定实体是否支持此协议，在可能的情况下，它应使用实体能力 (XEP-0115) 中定义的基于存在的动态服务发现配置文件。然而，如果应用程序尚未从实体收到实体能力信息，则应使用显式服务发现。

### SDP Offer / Answer Support（SDP Offer/Answer 支持）

If an entity supports the SDP offer / answer model described in RFC 3264
> RFC 3264: An Offer/Answer Model with the Session Description Protocol (SDP) <http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3264>.
and therefore prefers to receive multiple candidates in a single transport-info message, it MUST advertise support for the "urn:ietf:rfc:3264" service discovery feature. Typically this feature will be advertised only by gateways between Jingle and SIP.

如果实体支持 RFC 3264 中描述的 SDP offer/answer 模型，因此更喜欢在单个 transport-info 消息中接收多个候选，则它必须广告对 "urn:ietf:rfc:3264" 服务发现功能的支持。通常，此功能仅由 Jingle 和 SIP 之间的网关广告。

```xml
<iq from='gateway.capulet.lit'
    id='disco2'
    to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard'
    type='result'>
  <query xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/disco#info'>
    <feature var='urn:xmpp:jingle:1'/>
    <feature var='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1'/>
    <feature var='urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:raw-udp:1'/>
    <feature var='urn:ietf:rfc:3264'/>
  </query>
</iq>
```

```xml

    id='disco2'
    to='gateway.capulet.lit'
    type='get'>
  <query xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/disco#info'/>
</iq>
```

## Implementation Notes（实现说明）

In order to speed the negotiation process so that media can flow as quickly as possible, the initiator SHOULD gather and prioritize candidates in advance, or as soon as the principal begins the process of initiating a session.

为了加快协商过程以便媒体能够尽快流动，发起方应提前或在主体开始发起会话的过程时立即收集候选并对其进行优先级排序。

---

## Deployment Notes（部署注意事项）

This specification applies exclusively to Jingle clients and places no additional requirements on XMPP servers. However, service administrators might wish to deploy a STUN server in order to ease the client-to-client negotiation process and a TURN server for media relaying (see TURN
> Traversal Using Relays around NAT (TURN): Relay Extensions to Session Traversal Utilities for NAT (STUN) <http://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-ietf-behave-turn>. Work in progress.
). Deployment of support for External Service Discovery (XEP-0215)
> XEP-0215: External Service Discovery <https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-0215.html>.
might also be helpful.

本规范仅适用于 Jingle 客户端，不对 XMPP 服务器提出额外要求。但是，服务管理员可能希望部署 STUN 服务器以简化客户端到客户端的协商过程，以及部署 TURN 服务器用于媒体中继（参见 TURN——NAT 周围中继穿越：NAT 会话穿越工具的扩展中继。正在进行的工作）。部署对外部服务发现 (XEP-0215) 的支持也可能有帮助。

---

## Security Considerations（安全考虑）

### Sharing of IP Addresses（IP 地址共享）

By definition, the exchange of transport candidates results in exposure of the sender's IP addresses, which comprise a form of personally identifying information. A Jingle client MUST enable a user to control which entities will be allowed to receive such information. If a human user explicitly accepts a session request, then the client SHOULD consider that action to imply approval of IP address sharing. However, waiting for a human user to explicitly accept the session request can result in delays during session setup, since it is more efficient to immediately begin sharing transport candidates. Therefore, it is RECOMMENDED for the client to immediately send transport candidates to a contact (without waiting for explicit user approval of the session request) in the following cases:
- The user has permanently and formally authorized the contact to view the user's presence information via a presence subscription as reflected in an XMPP roster item (see XMPP IM
> RFC 6121: Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol (XMPP): Instant Messaging and Presence <http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6121>.
).
- The user has temporarily and dynamically shared presence with the contact via "directed presence" as described in RFC 3921
> RFC 3921: Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol (XMPP): Instant Messaging and Presence <http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3921>.
.
- The user has explicitly added the contact to a list of entities who are allowed to access the user's personally-identifying information.

根据定义，传输候选的交换会导致发送方 IP 地址的暴露，这构成一种个人身份信息的形式。Jingle 客户端必须使用户能够控制允许哪些实体接收此类信息。如果人类用户明确接受会话请求，则客户端应将此操作视为暗示批准 IP 地址共享。然而，等待人类用户明确接受会话请求可能会导致会话建立过程中的延迟，因为立即开始共享传输候选更为高效。因此，建议客户端在以下情况下立即向联系人发送传输候选（无需等待用户对会话请求的明确批准）：
- 用户已通过反映在 XMPP 花名册项中的存在订阅（参见 XMPP IM, RFC 6121）永久并正式授权联系人查看用户的存在信息。
- 用户已通过 RFC 3921 中描述的"定向存在"临时且动态地与联系人共享存在信息。
- 用户已将联系人明确添加到允许访问用户个人身份信息的实体列表中。

### Encryption（加密）

A Jingle implementation SHOULD support security preconditions that are enforced before application media is allowed to flow over a UDP association, such as those described in Jingle XTLS
> Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol (XMPP) End-to-End Encryption Using Transport Layer Security ("XTLS") <http://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-meyer-xmpp-e2e-encryption>.
.

Jingle 实现应支持在允许应用媒体通过 UDP 关联流动之前强制执行的安全前提条件，例如在 Jingle XTLS（使用传输层安全的 XMPP 端到端加密）中描述的那些。

Application types that use the Jingle ICE-UDP transport method MAY also define their own application-specific encryption methods, such as the Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP) for RTP exchanges as described in Jingle RTP Sessions (XEP-0167)
> XEP-0167: Jingle RTP Sessions <https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-0167.html>.
.

使用 Jingle ICE-UDP 传输方法的应用类型也可以定义自己的应用特定加密方法，例如 Jingle RTP 会话 (XEP-0167) 中描述的用于 RTP 交换的安全实时传输协议 (SRTP)。

---

## IANA Considerations（IANA 考虑）

This document requires no interaction with the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA)
> The Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) is the central coordinator for the assignment of unique parameter values for Internet protocols, such as port numbers and URI schemes. For further information, see <http://www.iana.org/>.
.

本文档不需要与互联网号码分配局 (IANA) 进行任何交互。
> 互联网号码分配局 (IANA) 是分配互联网协议唯一参数值（如端口号和 URI 方案）的中央协调机构。有关更多信息，请参见 <http://www.iana.org/>。

---

## XMPP Registrar Considerations（XMPP 注册机构考虑）

### Namespaces（命名空间）

This specification defines the following XML namespace:
- urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1

本规范定义了以下 XML 命名空间：
- urn:xmpp:jingle:transports:ice-udp:1

The XMPP Registrar
> The XMPP Registrar maintains a list of reserved protocol namespaces as well as registries of parameters used in the context of XMPP extension protocols approved by the XMPP Standards Foundation. For further information, see <https://xmpp.org/registrar/>.
includes the foregoing namespace in its registry at <https://xmpp.org/registrar/namespaces.html>, as governed by XMPP Registrar Function (XEP-0053)
> XEP-0053: XMPP Registrar Function <https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-0053.html>.
.

XMPP 注册机构在其注册表 <https://xmpp.org/registrar/namespaces.html> 中包含了前述命名空间，受 XMPP 注册机构功能 (XEP-0053) 的管理。

If the protocol defined in this specification undergoes a revision that is not fully backwards-compatible with an older version, the XMPP Registrar shall increment the protocol version number found at the end of the XML namespaces defined herein, as described in Section 4 of XEP-0053.

If an entity supports the SDP offer / answer model described in RFC 3264
> RFC 3264: An Offer/Answer Model with the Session Description Protocol (SDP) <http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3264>.
and therefore prefers to receive one transport-info message with multiple candidates, it MUST advertise support for the "urn:ietf:rfc:3264" feature.

如果实体支持 RFC 3264 中描述的 SDP offer/answer 模型，因此更喜欢接收包含多个候选的单个 transport-info 消息，则它必须广告对 "urn:ietf:rfc:3264" 功能的支持。

10	# RFC 8445 (ICE) 协议分析
11	
12	## 一句话理解
13	
14	**ICE = Interactive Connectivity Establishment**，一种 NAT 穿透协议，通过系统性测试多个候选地址对，找出能工作的直接通信路径。
15	
16	---
17	
18	## 语义层 (What - 说什么)
19	
20	### 核心概念
21	
22	| 术语 | 语义含义 |
23	|------|----------|
24	| **ICE Agent** | ICE 协议实现者（发起方或响应方） |
25	| **Candidate (候选)** | 可用于通信的 IP+端口地址 |
26	| **Candidate Pair (候选对)** | 本地候选 + 远程候选的配对 |
27	| **Checklist (检查清单)** | 按优先级排序的候选对列表 |
28	| **Valid Pair (有效对)** | 通过连接性检查的候选对 |
29	| **Selected Pair (选中对)** | 最终用于传输数据的候选对 |
30	| **Foundation** | 用于分组的字符串，相同类型/基础地址的候选共享相同 Foundation |
31	
32	### 候选类型
33	
34	| 类型 | 英文名 | 说明 | 获取方式 | 推荐优先级 |
35	|------|--------|------|----------|-----------|
36	| **Host** | Host Candidate | 主机物理/虚拟网卡地址 | 直接绑定 | 126 (最高) |
37	| **Srflx** | Server-Reflexive | NAT 分配的公网地址 | STUN Binding | 100 |
38	| **Prflx** | Peer-Reflexive | 对端 NAT 分配的地址 | 连接性检查发现 | 110 |
39	| **Relay** | Relayed | TURN 服务器中继地址 | TURN Allocate | 0 (最低) |
40	
41	### 候选关系图
42	
43	```
44	                    To Internet
45	                        |
46	                        | /------------  Relayed Address (Y:y)
47	                    Y:y |
48	                    +--------+
49	                    |  TURN  |
50	                    | Server |
51	                    +--------+
52	                        |
53	                        | /------------  Server-Reflexive (X1':x1')
54	                 X1':x1'|
55	                 +------------+
56	                 |    NAT     |
57	                 +------------+
58	                        |
59	                        | /------------  Local Address (X:x)
60	                    X:x |
61	                    +--------+
62	                    |  Agent |
63	                    +--------+
64	```
65	
66	### 角色语义
67	
68	| 角色 | 英文名 | 职责 |
69	|------|--------|------|
70	| **Controlling Agent** | 控制方 | 负责提名候选对 |
71	| **Controlled Agent** | 被控方 | 等待控制方提名 |
72	
73	### 实现类型
74	
75	| 类型 | 说明 |
76	|------|------|
77	| **Full Implementation** | 完整实现，执行全部 ICE 功能，包括连通性检查 |
78	| **Lite Implementation** | 简化实现，只用 Host 候选，不生成检查，适用于公网 IP 终端 |
79	
80	---
81	
82	## 语法层 (How - 怎么说)
83	
84	### 候选信息交换格式
85	
86	每个候选需携带的信息：
87	
88	```
89	Candidate Information:
90	├── Address: IP + Port
91	├── Transport: 传输协议（UDP/TCP）
92	├── Foundation: 字符串（最多32字符）
93	├── Component ID: 组件ID（RTP=1, RTCP=2）
94	├── Priority: 32位优先级
95	├── Type: 候选类型
96	├── Related Address: 关联地址
97	└── Base: 基准地址
98	
99	Session Information:
100	├── Username Fragment: 至少24位随机
101	├── Password: 至少128位随机
102	├── Lite/Full: 实现类型
103	└── ICE Options: 扩展选项（如 ice2）
104	```
105	
106	### 候选优先级公式
107	
108	```
109	priority = (2^24) × type_preference +
110	           (2^8) × local_preference +
111	           (2^0) × (256 - component_id)
112	
113	推荐 type_preference:
114	- Host: 126 (最高)
115	- Peer-Reflexive: 110
116	- Server-Reflexive: 100
117	- Relayed: 0 (最低)
118	
119	local_preference: 0-65535，IPv4 单地址推荐 65535
120	component_id: 组件ID，RTP=1, RTCP=2
121	```
122	
123	### 候选对优先级公式
124	
125	```
126	pair_priority = 2^32 × MIN(G,D) + 2 × MAX(G,D) + (G>D?1:0)
127	
128	其中:
129	- G = 控制方(controlling)候选的优先级
130	- D = 被控方(controlled)候选的优先级
131	```
132	
133	### ICE 扩展的 STUN 属性
134	
135	| 属性 | 类型值 | 作用 |
136	|------|--------|------|
137	| `PRIORITY` | 0x0024 | 声明候选优先级 |
138	| `USE-CANDIDATE` | 0x0025 | 提名候选对（控制方使用） |
139	| `ICE-CONTROLLING` | 0x8029 | 声明自己是控制方，含 tiebreaker |
140	| `ICE-CONTROLLED` | 0x802A | 声明自己是被控方 |
141	
142	### ICE 错误码
143	
144	| 错误码 | 含义 |
145	|--------|------|
146	| 487 | Role Conflict - 角色冲突，需要切换角色 |
147	
148	---
149	
150	## 时序层 (When - 何时说)
151	
152	### ICE 完整流程
153	
154	```
155	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
156	│  阶段 1: 候选收集 (Candidate Gathering)                       │
157	├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
158	│  Agent L                    Agent R                         │
159	│    │                           │                            │
160	│    ├─ 收集 Host Candidates ───▶│                            │
161	│    ├─ STUN Binding ──────────▶│ (获取 Server-Reflexive)     │
162	│    ├─ TURN Allocate ─────────▶│ (获取 Relayed)              │
163	│    │                           │◀─ 收集 Host Candidates     │
164	│    │                           │◀─ STUN Binding             │
165	│    │                           │◀─ TURN Allocate            │
166	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
167	
168	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
169	│  阶段 2: 候选交换 (Candidate Exchange)                        │
170	├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
171	│    │                           │                            │
172	│    ├─ Offer (候选列表) ───────▶│  ← 通过信令通道（SDP等）       │
173	│    │                           │                            │
174	│    │◀─ Answer (候选列表) ──────┤                             │
175	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
176	
177	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
178	│  阶段 3: 连接性检查 (Connectivity Checks)                    │
179	├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
180	│                                                             │
181	│    L                              R                         │
182	│    │                               │                        │
183	│    │◀════ STUN Request ══════════│  (对端发起的检查)         │
184	│    │════ STUN Response ══════════▶│                        │
185	│    │                              │                       │
186	│    │════ STUN Request ══════════▶│  (己方发起的检查)       │
187	│    │◀════ STUN Response ═════════│                        │
188	│                                                             │
189	│  这形成 4-way handshake，双方互相验证连通性                  │
190	│  发现 Peer-Reflexive 候选                                   │
191	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
192	
193	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
194	│  阶段 4: 提名 (Nomination)                                  │
195	├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
196	│    │                               │                        │
197	│    │  (Controlling Agent 提名)      │                        │
198	│    │════ STUN Req + USE-CAND ────▶│                        │
199	│    │◀═══ STUN Response ═══════════│                        │
200	│    │                               │ (设置 nominated flag)   │
201	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
202	
203	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
204	│  阶段 5: 完成 (ICE Completed)                               │
205	├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
206	│    │                               │                        │
207	│    │  Selected Pair = 最终通信路径  │                        │
208	│    │  使用该路径传输媒体数据        │                        │
209	│    │  保活: Binding Indication     │                        │
210	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
211	```
212	
213	### 候选对状态机
214	
215	```
216	                    ┌──────────┐
217	                    │  Frozen  │  ← 初始状态，等待解冻
218	                    └────┬─────┘
219	                         │ unfreeze
220	                         ▼
221	                    ┌──────────┐
222	                    │ Waiting  │  ← 等待发送检查
223	                    └────┬─────┘
224	                         │ perform check
225	                         ▼
226	              ┌──────────┴──────────┐
227	              │                     │
228	         In-Progress           In-Progress
229	         (检查中)               (检查中)
230	              │                     │
231	        failure│              success│
232	              ▼                     ▼
233	         ┌──────────┐          ┌──────────┐
234	         │  Failed  │          │ Succeeded │ ← 有效对
235	         └──────────┘          └──────────┘
236	```
237	
238	### ICE 会话状态
239	
240	| 状态 | 含义 |
241	|------|------|
242	| **Running** | ICE 正在进行中 |
243	| **Completed** | 所有检查表都完成，找到可用路径 |
244	| **Failed** | 所有检查表都失败，无法建立连接 |
245	
246	### 定时器
247	
248	| 定时器 | 说明 | 默认值 |
249	|--------|------|--------|
250	| **Ta** | STUN/TURN 事务生成间隔 | 50ms |
251	| **RTO** | 重传超时 | 动态计算 |
252	
253	### ICE 重启
254	
255	触发条件：
256	- 改变数据流目的地
257	- 切换 Lite/Full 实现类型
258	- 更换密码和用户名片段
259	
260	---
261	
262	## 与 RFC 5245 的主要变化
263	
264	| 项目 | RFC 5245 (旧) | RFC 8445 (新) |
265	|------|---------------|---------------|
266	| 提名方式 | 支持 aggressive nomination | 移除，仅支持 regular nomination |
267	| 优先级算法 | 相同 | 已澄清，更加清晰 |
268	| 检查表初始化 | 仅第一个检查表 | 所有检查表并行初始化 |
269	| 协议识别 | 无特殊处理 | 更容易被 Wireshark 识别 |
270	
271	---
272	
273	## 一句话总结
274	
275	> **ICE = ==收集候选 + 交换地址 + 两两测试 + 选择最优路径**==
276	>
277	> **语法 = 候选信息(Candidate) + 候选对(Pair) + STUN扩展属性**
278	>
279	> **时序 = 收集→交换→检查(4-way)→提名→完成**
280	
281	---
282

toolCalls.result:
1	---
2	title: ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) 通俗理解
3	type: concept
4	tags: [webrtc, ice, nat-traversal, concept]
5	sources: [raw/rfcs/rfc8445.md]
6	created: 2026-04-21
7	updated: 2026-04-21
8	---
9	
10	# ICE 通俗理解
11	
12	## 一句话理解
13	
14	**ICE 就是让两个在 NAT 背后的设备，找到一条能直接通话的路。**
15	
16	就像两个人在不同的办公楼里，ICE 帮他们找出从哪个门、哪条路能最快速地相互到达。
17	
18	---
19	
20	## 三个阶段
21	
22	### 阶段一：候选者收集 —— 我有哪些可以联系你的方式？
23	
24	想象你要寄快递给朋友，你需要先列出所有可能的收货地址：
25	
26	| 候选者类型 | 通俗解释 | 类比 |
27	|------------|----------|------|
28	| **Host（主机候选）** | 我电脑的真实 IP 和端口 | 你家的门牌号 |
29	| **Srflx（服务器反射候选）** | NAT 给我分配的公网地址 | 小区的快递柜地址 |
30	| **Relay（中继候选）** | TURN 服务器给我的中转地址 | 菜鸟驿站 |
31	
32	**为什么要收集这么多？**
33	- 直接连接最快，但可能不通（NAT 阻断）
34	- 中继最慢，但最可靠
35	- ICE 的目标是**先试快的，不行再换慢的**
36	
37	---
38	
39	### 阶段二：连接检查 —— 哪些路走得通？
40	
41	收集完候选者后，双方交换地址列表，然后**一条一条测试**：
42	
43	```
44	A 的候选地址  ←→  B 的候选地址
45	   ↓
46	  配对测试
47	   ↓
48	  记录结果
49	```
50	
51	**测试方式**：发送 STUN 请求，就像敲门问"有人在吗？"
52	
53	```
54	     A                              B
55	     │                              │
56	     │ ─── STUN Binding Request ───▶│  "我能找到你吗？"
57	     │ ◀── STUN Binding Response ──│  "找到了！这是我的位置"
58	     │                              │
59	     │ ◀── STUN Binding Request ───│  "我也能找到你吗？"
60	     │ ─── STUN Binding Response ──▶│  "找到了！"
61	     │
62	     ✓ 双向确认：这条路通了！
63	```
64	
65	**为什么叫"候选者对"？**
66	- A 有 3 个地址，B 有 4 个地址
67	- 理论上最多 3×4 = 12 条可能的路
68	- 每条路 = 一个"候选者对"
69	
70	---
71	
72	### 阶段三：路径提名与选择 —— 选一条最好的！
73	
74	测试完成后，所有行得通的路都是"有效对"，但只能选一条：
75	
76	**优先级规则**（一般情况）：
77	```
78	直连 > NAT 反射 > 中继
79	```
80	
81	| 路径类型 | 速度 | 可靠性 | 优先级 |
82	|----------|------|--------|--------|
83	| 直连（两个公网 IP） | 最快 | 中 | 高 |
84	| NAT 反射（至少一方在 NAT 后） | 中 | 中 | 中 |
85	| 中继（TURN 服务器转发） | 慢 | 高 | 低 |
86	
87	**提名过程**：
88	- 一方扮演"控制者"，负责挑选
89	- 另一方扮演"被控制者"，等待通知
90	- 控制者说"用这条路！"→ 双方确认 → 开始传数据
91	
92	---
93	
94	## 为什么要用 ICE？
95	
96	### 没有 ICE 的问题
97	
98	```
99	A (192.168.1.5:5000) ──┐
100	                        ├── ??? ──▶ B (192.168.1.8:8000)
101	 NAT ───────────────────┘       NAT
102	公网: 1.2.3.4:5000             公网: 5.6.7.8:8000
103	```
104	
105	- A 以为发给 `192.168.1.8:8000` 就行
106	- 但 B 在自己的 NAT 后面，根本收不到
107	- NAT 也不知道该把包转给谁
108	
109	### 有 ICE 的好处
110	
111	1. **自动适应**：不管什么网络环境，ICE 都能找出能通的路
112	2. **择优选择**：优先用直连（最快），不行再换中继（最稳）
113	3. **对等透明**：两端都要测试，双向确认才放心
114	
115	---
116	
117	## 通俗流程图
118	
119	```
120	开始
121	  │
122	  ▼
123	┌─────────────────────────┐
124	│  第一步：收集候选地址      │
125	│  "我有哪些可以联系你的方式？" │
126	└───────────┬─────────────┘
127	            │
128	            ▼
129	┌─────────────────────────┐
130	│  第二步：交换地址列表      │
131	│  通过信令服务器告诉对方    │
132	└───────────┬─────────────┘
133	            │
134	            ▼
135	┌─────────────────────────┐
136	│  第三步：测试所有路径      │
137	│  "这条路通不通？那条呢？"  │
138	└───────────┬─────────────┘
139	            │
140	            ▼
141	┌─────────────────────────┐
142	│  第四步：选择最优路径      │
143	│  "用这条！开始通话！"     │
144	└───────────┬─────────────┘
145	            │
146	            ▼
147	         成功！
148	```
149	
150	---
151	
152	## 关键概念速查
153	
154	| 概念 | 通俗解释 |
155	|------|----------|
156	| Candidate | 候选地址 = "我能联系你的一个可能地址" |
157	| Candidate Pair | 候选对 = "我的一个地址 + 你的一个地址" |
158	| STUN | 敲门工具 = "问 NAT：我现在对外是什么地址？" |
159	| TURN | 快递驿站 = "直接送不到，你来这儿取" |
160	| Nomination | 选定路径 = "就用这条路打电话！" |
161	| Controlling Agent | 控制者 = 负责选路的一方 |
162	| Controlled Agent | 被控制者 = 等待被选中的一方 |
163	
164	---
165	
166	## 参考
167	
168	- 详细协议: [[wiki/protocols/protocol-rfc8445]]
169	- **候选收集: [[wiki/tutorials/tutorial-ice-candidate-gathering]]** ← STUN/TURN TLV 变化详解
170	- **连接性检查与提名: [[wiki/tutorials/tutorial-ice-connectivity-checks]]** ← 4-way Handshake + 提名流程
171	- **UDP打洞详解: [[wiki/tutorials/tutorial-udp-hole-punching]]** ← 打洞原理、NAT适配、候选交换全场景
172	- [[wiki/protocols/protocol-rfc5389]] - STUN 协议分析
173	- [[wiki/protocols/protocol-rfc5766]] - TURN 协议分析
174	- RFC 原文: [[raw/rfcs/rfc8445]]

    Note over C,S: 事务 3 (超时重传)

**STUN Error Class (lines 682-687)**

**STUN Error Response in TURN Flow (lines 921-930)**

│    │◀─── 0x000F Error ────────│  需要认证                     │

**ERROR-CODE Attribute (line 1011)**

**Timing Parameters (lines 1230-1237)**

---

### FILE 5: `Z:\knowledge\knowledge_webrtc\wiki\tutorials\tutorial-udp-hole-punching.md`

This file contains the richest discussion of failure scenarios among the wiki tutorials.

**NAT Mapping Timeout (lines 257-267)**
```
│  NAT 映射表条目                                              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  内部地址     公网地址      目标地址        超时计时器           │
│  10.0.0.1    1.2.3.4      5.6.7.8        30s ←              │
│  :4000       :60000       :55000         倒计时              │
│                                                             │
│  每当有数据包匹配此条目时，计时器重置                            │
```

**Asymmetric Packet Arrival / Hole Reopening (lines 275-295)**
```
  t=0ms:    Alice 发包 → NAT-A 开洞 → 包到达 NAT-B → 被丢弃
  t=5000ms: NAT-A 的洞还在 (超时一般为 30-120s)
  t=5000ms: Bob 发包 → NAT-B 开洞 → 包到达 NAT-A → 找到映射 → 放行！
  t=5001ms: Alice 再发包 → NAT-B 已有映射 → 放行！
  → ✅ 仍然成功！

但实际工程中：
  - "同时"不是严格同步，而是双方都主动触发

当一方包先到并且被丢弃，另一方的包随后到达时：
  - 先到被丢弃的包 → 在自己 NAT 上开了洞
  - 随后到达的包 → 对方的洞已开，可以进来
  - 再重试一次 → 两边的洞都已开 → P2P 建立

这就是为什么连接性检查需要多次重试。
```

**Symmetric NAT Failure (lines 337-344)**
```
### Symmetric NAT → 打洞失败

NAT-A (Symmetric): 
  发给 Rendezvous → 映射为 1.2.3.4:60000
  发给 Bob → 映射为 1.2.3.4:60001（不同！）
```
Symmetric NAT assigns different port mappings per destination, making hole punching impossible because the peer does not know the correct port to use.

**Multiple Retries Strategy (lines 384-392)**
```
│  实际情况：总有一方先到达                                       │
│    先到方的包 → 在对方 NAT 被丢弃（对方还没开洞）                 │
│    但先到方的包 → 在自己的 NAT 上开了洞                         │

## Summary of ICE Error Handling Taxonomy

Based on all files examined, ICE error/exception handling can be categorized as follows:

| Category | Where Defined | Mechanism |
|----------|--------------|-----------|
| **Role Conflict** | RFC 8445 Sec 7.2.5.1, 7.3.1.1, 16.2, 20.2; protocol-rfc8445 lines 142-146 | Error code 487; agent switches role, requeues pair, recomputes priorities |
| **Timeout** | RFC 8445 Sec 7.2.5.2.3 | Binding request transaction timeout -> pair state set to Failed |
| **Non-Symmetric Addresses** | RFC 8445 Sec 7.2.5.2.1 | Response src/dst mismatch with request -> pair state set to Failed |
| **ICMP Error** | RFC 8445 Sec 7.2.5.2.2 | Hard ICMP -> SHOULD set pair state to Failed; DoS risk noted |
| **Unrecoverable STUN Response** | RFC 8445 Sec 7.2.5.2.4 | Unrecoverable STUN error -> SHOULD set pair state to Failed |
| **Recoverable Gathering Error** | RFC 8445, rfc8445.md lines 1022-1029; tutorial-ice-candidate-gathering lines 844-851 | Retry on next Ta tick (e.g., authentication failure) |
| **Nomination Failure** | RFC 8445 Sec 7.2.5.3.4 | Pair removed from valid list, both pair and checklist set to Failed |
| **Checklist Aggregate Failure** | RFC 8445 Sec 6.1.2.1, 7.2.5.4 | All pairs Failed/Succeeded with no valid pair -> checklist Failed |
| **ICE Session Failure** | RFC 8445 Sec 6.1.3, 8.1.2 | All checklists Failed -> ICE session Failed |
| **Symmetric NAT Failure** | tutorial-udp-hole-punching lines 337-344, 1038-1041 | Cannot predict port -> fallback to TURN relay |
| **NAT Timeout During Hole Punch** | tutorial-udp-hole-punching lines 409-416 | Fast retransmission (RTO=500ms, exponential backoff) |
| **Stale Candidate Info** | tutorial-udp-hole-punching lines 420-427 | Regather candidates before connectivity checks |
| **STUN Demux Failure** | tutorial-ice-candidate-gathering lines 1082-1088 | Pass packet to other protocol handler |
| **Check Scheduling Abort** | RFC 8445 Sec 6.1.4.1 | Abort subsequent steps when no checks can be scheduled |
| **ICE Restart** | RFC 8445 Sec 9; protocol-rfc8445 lines 253-258 | Trigger on destination change, role switch, credential change |
| **RTO (Retransmission)** | All files that mention timers | Dynamic RTT-based retransmission for STUN/TURN transactions |

9	
10	# ICE 异常处理完整分析
11	
12	> ICE (RFC 8445) 的异常处理是一个多层级的、贯穿整个连接建立生命周期的体系。从候选收集、连接性检查、提名到会话终结，每个阶段都有对应的错误检测和恢复机制。
13	
14	---
15	
16	## 一、异常处理架构总览
17	
18	```
19	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
20	│                    ICE 异常处理层次                       │
21	├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
22	│                                                         │
23	│   L1: 事务级  ── STUN 超时重传 (RTO)、认证失败重试        │
24	│       ↓                                                 │
25	│   L2: 对级    ── 候选对状态机 → Failed                  │
26	│       ↓                                                 │
27	│   L3: 检查表级 ── Checklist → Failed (全部对失败)        │
28	│       ↓                                                 │
29	│   L4: 会话级  ── ICE Session → Failed (全部表失败)       │
30	│       ↓                                                 │
31	│   L5: 恢复级  ── ICE Restart、TURN 降级                  │
32	│                                                         │
33	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
34	```
35	
36	核心设计理念：**层层上报，逐级兜底**。下层能处理的不上报，处理不了的向上传递，直到触发 ICE Restart 或 TURN 降级。
37	
38	---
39	
40	## 二、候选收集阶段的异常
41	
42	### 2.1 可恢复错误 → 重试
43	
44	候选收集由定时器 `Ta`（默认 50ms）驱动。每次 `Ta` 到期，代理可以发起新的 STUN/TURN 事务。
45	
46	```
47	每个 Ta 周期:
48	  ├── 可恢复错误 (如 401 认证失败) → 重试该事务
49	  └── 正常 → 为新候选发起事务
50	```
51	
52	**典型场景**：TURN Allocate 请求返回 `401 Unauthorized`（需要认证），客户端添加 `MESSAGE-INTEGRITY` 后重试。
53	
54	### 2.2 主机候选失效
55	
56	主机候选不会超时，但底层网络接口可能发生变化（IP 变更、网卡禁用）：
57	
58	> ICE 代理应该监控其使用的接口，使基础已消失的候选者失效。
59	
60	**对策**：在连接性检查开始前重新验证候选有效性。
61	
62	### 2.3 不可恢复错误 → 跳过
63	
64	| 错误类型 | 处理 |
65	|----------|------|
66	| TURN 服务器不可达 | 跳过该服务器，不生成 relay 候选 |
67	| STUN 服务器无响应 | 跳过，不生成 srflx 候选 |
68	| 协议栈不支持 IPv6 | 跳过 IPv6 候选 |
69	
70	---
71	
72	## 三、连接性检查阶段的异常
73	
74	这是 ICE 异常处理最复杂的部分。RFC 8445 Section 7.2.5 详细定义了四种失败模式。
75	
76	### 3.1 候选对状态机
77	
78	```
79	                    ┌──────────┐
80	                    │  Frozen  │  ← 初始状态
81	                    └────┬─────┘
82	                         │ unfreeze
83	                         ▼
84	                    ┌──────────┐
85	                    │ Waiting  │
86	                    └────┬─────┘
87	                         │ 触发检查
88	                         ▼
89	                    ┌──────────┐
90	         failure    │In-Progress│   success
91	         ┌──────────│          │──────────┐
92	         ▼          └──────────┘          ▼
93	    ┌──────────┐                    ┌──────────┐
94	    │  Failed  │                    │ Succeeded│
95	    └──────────┘                    └────┬─────┘
96	                                        │ 提名
97	                                        ▼
98	                                   ┌──────────┐
99	                                   │ Nominated│
100	                                   └──────────┘
101	```
102	
103	`Failed` 状态可能因以下任一种情况触发。
104	
105	### 3.2 失败模式一：事务超时 (Timeout)
106	
107	**触发条件**：Binding 请求的 STUN 事务超时（RTO 到期后未收到响应）。
108	
109	**处理**：候选对状态 MUST 设为 Failed。
110	
111	```
112	Initiator                     Responder
113	    │                             │
114	    │──── Binding Request ───────▶│
115	    │       (TID=0xABC)          │
116	    │                             │
117	    │   RTO 到期, 无响应           │
118	    │   重传 Binding Request      │
119	    │       (TID=0xABC)          │
120	    │                             │
121	    │   Rc 次重传后仍无响应        │
122	    │                             │
123	    │   候选对 → Failed           │
124	```
125	
126	RFC 8445 Section 7.2.5.2.3：
127	
128	> 如果代理是控制代理，并且 ICE 代理尚未为该数据流生成有效列表，它可以在成对的 STUN 事务上增加超时重传次数，直到有效列表全部填充。
129	
130	**关键细节**：控制代理在尚无有效对时可以"超限重试"，因为找不到可用路径的代价远大于多等几秒。
131	
132	### 3.3 失败模式二：非对称传输地址 (Non-Symmetric)
133	
134	**触发条件**：响应的源/目标 IP+Port 与请求不匹配。
135	
136	```
137	请求: src=10.0.0.1:4000, dst=1.2.3.4:6000
138	响应: src=1.2.3.4:6001, dst=10.0.0.1:4000
139	        ↑ 端口变了！→ 非对称 → Failed
140	```
141	
142	**处理**：候选对 MUST 设为 Failed。这是防止 IP 欺骗的关键安全措施。
143	
144	RFC 8445 Section 7.2.5.2.1：
145	
146	> 如果 Binding 请求的 STUN 事务生成成功响应，但响应中传输地址与请求不匹配（非对称），代理 MUST 将候选对状态设为 Failed。
147	
148	### 3.4 失败模式三：ICMP 错误
149	
150	**触发条件**：收到 ICMP 错误消息（如 Destination Unreachable）。
151	
152	**处理**：
153	
154	| ICMP 类型 | 处理 |
155	|-----------|------|
156	| Hard error (Host/Network Unreachable) | SHOULD 设为 Failed |
157	| Soft error (TTL Exceeded, Port Unreachable) | 可忽略，继续重试 |
158	| 任何 ICMP | 警惕 DoS 攻击（伪造 ICMP） |
159	
160	RFC 8445 对此持谨慎态度：
161	
162	> 代理 MAY 处理 ICMP 错误。硬 ICMP 错误 SHOULD 将候选对设为 Failed。注意 ICMP 可能被伪造，用于 DoS 攻击。
163	
164	### 3.5 失败模式四：不可恢复的 STUN 响应
165	
166	**触发条件**：收到非 487 的 STUN 错误响应（如 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 420 Unknown Attribute）。
167	
168	**处理**：SHOULD 将候选对设为 Failed（非强制性，留给实现灵活处理）。
169	
170	### 3.6 特殊异常：角色冲突 (Role Conflict) — 487
171	
172	这是 ICE 唯一定义的错误响应码。
173	
174	```
175	场景:
176	  Agent A (认为自己是 controlling) 发送: ICE-CONTROLLING
177	  Agent B (也认为自己是 controlling) 收到后生成 487
178	
179	处理流程:
180	  1. B 返回 487 (Role Conflict) 错误响应
181	  2. A 收到 487
182	     - 如果 A 发了 ICE-CONTROLLING → 切换到 controlled
183	     - 如果 A 发了 ICE-CONTROLLED → 切换到 controlling
184	  3. A 重新计算候选对优先级
185	  4. A 将该候选对加入 triggered-check 队列，状态设为 Waiting
186	  5. 下次检查时以正确的角色重试
187	```
188	
189	**关键**：角色冲突不是真正的"失败"——它是可自动恢复的，不将候选对设为 Failed。这与四种失败模式有本质区别。
190	
191	---
192	
193	## 四、提名阶段的异常
194	
195	提名失败比普通连接性检查失败**更严重**——因为它意味着已经被标记为"可用"的路径突然失效了。
196

198

200	> 1. 从有效列表中移除该候选对

973	
974	There are two cases when forming a request. In the first case, this is the first request from the client to the server (as identified by its IP address and port). In the second case, the client is submitting a subsequent request once a previous request/response transaction has completed successfully. Forming a request as a consequence of a 401 or 438 error response is covered in [Section 10.2.3](#section-10.2.3) and is not considered a "subsequent request" and thus does not utilize the rules described in [Section 10.2.1.2](#section-10.2.1.2).

980	##### 10.2.1.1. First Request | 10.2.1.1. 第一次请求
981	
982	If the client has not completed a successful request/response transaction with the server (as identified by hostname, if the DNS procedures of [Section 9](#section-9) are used, else IP address if not), it SHOULD omit the USERNAME, MESSAGE-INTEGRITY, REALM, and NONCE attributes. 990	Once a request/response transaction has completed successfully, the client will have been presented a realm and nonce by the server, and selected a username and password with which it authenticated. The client SHOULD cache the username, password, realm, and nonce for subsequent communications with the server. When the client sends a subsequent request, it SHOULD include the USERNAME, REALM, and NONCE attributes with these cached values. It SHOULD include a MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute, computed as described in [Section 15.4](#section-15.4) using the cached password.

998	After the server has done the basic processing of a request, it performs the checks listed below in the order specified:

1000	服务器完成请求的基本处理后，按指定顺序执行以下检查：
1001	
1002	- If the message does not contain a MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute, the server MUST generate an error response with an error code of 401 (Unauthorized). This response MUST include a REALM value. It is RECOMMENDED that the REALM value be the domain name of the provider of the STUN server. The response MUST include a NONCE, selected by the server. The response SHOULD NOT contain a USERNAME or MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute.
1003	- 如果消息不包含 MESSAGE-INTEGRITY 属性，服务器必须生成错误响应，错误代码为 401（未授权）。此响应必须包含 REALM 值。建议 REALM 值为 STUN 服务器提供商的域名。响应必须包含由服务器选择的 NONCE。响应不应该包含 USERNAME 或 MESSAGE-INTEGRITY 属性。
1004	
1005	- If the message contains a MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute, but is missing the USERNAME, REALM, or NONCE attribute, the server MUST generate an error response with an error code of 400 (Bad Request). This response SHOULD NOT include a USERNAME, NONCE, REALM, or MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute.
1006	- 如果消息包含 MESSAGE-INTEGRITY 属性，但缺少 USERNAME、REALM 或 NONCE 属性，服务器必须生成错误响应，错误代码为 400（错误请求）。此响应不应该包含 USERNAME、NONCE、REALM 或 MESSAGE-INTEGRITY 属性。
1007	
1008	- If the NONCE is no longer valid, the server MUST generate an error response with an error code of 438 (Stale Nonce). This response MUST include NONCE and REALM attributes and SHOULD NOT include the USERNAME or MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute. Servers can invalidate nonces in order to provide additional security. See [Section 4.3 of RFC 2617](./rfc2617#section-4.3) for guidelines.
1009	- 如果 NONCE 不再有效，服务器必须生成错误响应，错误代码为 438（过期 Nonce）。此响应必须包含 NONCE 和 REALM 属性，不应该包含 USERNAME 或 MESSAGE-INTEGRITY 属性。服务器可以使 nonce 失效以提供额外的安全性。参见 [RFC 2617 第 4.3 节](./rfc2617#section-4.3) 获取指南。
1010	
1011	- If the username in the USERNAME attribute is not valid, the server MUST generate an error response with an error code of 401 (Unauthorized). This response MUST include a REALM value. 1014	- Using the password associated with the username in the USERNAME attribute, compute the value for the message integrity as described in [Section 15.4](#section-15.4). If the resulting value does not match the contents of the MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute, the server MUST reject the request with an error response. This response MUST use an error code of 401 (Unauthorized). It MUST include REALM and NONCE attributes and SHOULD NOT include the USERNAME or MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute.

1019	If these checks pass, the server continues to process the request. Any response generated by the server (excepting the cases described above) MUST include the MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute, computed using the username and password utilized to authenticate the request. The REALM, NONCE, and USERNAME attributes SHOULD NOT be included.

200	> 1. 从有效列表中移除该候选对
201	> 2. 将候选对状态设为 Failed
202	> 3. 将检查列表状态设为 Failed
203	
204	**连锁反应**：一次提名失败直接导致整个 Checklist Failed，触发回退到其他候选对或 ICE Restart。
205	
206	---
207	
208	## 五、聚合失败：从候选对到 ICE 会话
209	
210	### 5.1 Checklist 级别
211	
212	```
213	Checklist 判定为 Failed 的条件:
214	  所有候选对处于 Failed 或 Succeeded 状态
215	  AND 有效列表中没有有效对 (valid pair)
216	```
217	
218	换言之：所有可能的路径都试过了，但没有一条能用的。
219	
220	### 5.2 ICE 会话级别
221	
222	```
223	ICE 状态机:
224	  Running   → 检查进行中
225	  Completed → 所有 Checklist 都有 nominated pair
226	  Failed    → 所有 Checklist 都是 Failed
227	```
228	
229	**注意区分**：Succeeded ≠ Completed。Succeeded 意味着检查列表有 valid pair；Completed 要求 checklists 有 nominated pair。
230	
231	---
232	
233	## 六、恢复机制
234	
235	### 6.1 检查调度中的提前中止
236	
237	在每轮检查调度中，如果没有可执行的检查，ICE 代理会"中止后续步骤"(abort subsequent steps)。这是一种防御性设计——避免在不可能有进展的情况下浪费计算资源。
238	
239	### 6.2 终止检查（本地策略）
240	
241	> 代理可以选择随时终止对检查列表集中一个或多个检查列表执行连通性检查。
242	
243	这是一个逃生阀：如果应用层判断继续尝试无意义（如用户挂断电话），可以主动终止。
244	
245	### 6.3 ICE Restart
246	
247	当以下任一条件满足时触发 ICE Restart：
248	
249	| 触发条件 | 典型场景 |
250	|----------|---------|
251	| 数据流目标地址变化 | WiFi 切 4G，IP 地址变更 |
252	| Lite/Full 实现类型切换 | 与不支持 Full ICE 的旧设备互通 |
253	| 密码和 ufrag 变更 | 安全策略要求刷新凭证 |
254	| ICE 会话 Failed | 所有路径都断开 |
255	
256	Restart 时重新生成 `pwd` 和 `ufrag`，generation 值递增（+1），整个 ICE 流程重来。
257	
258	### 6.4 TURN 降级
259	
260	当所有直连/打洞路径（host、srflx）都失败时，TURN 中继候选作为**最终兜底**：
261	
262	```
263	优先级: host > srflx > relay(TURN)
264	失败时: host Failed → 尝试 srflx → srflx Failed → 使用 TURN
265	```
266	
267	TURN 几乎总是能连通（只要中继服务器可达），代价是带宽和延迟开销。
268	
269	---
270	
271	## 七、NAT 层面的异常
272	
273	UDP 打洞本身不是 ICE 的一部分，但 ICE 的连接性检查本质上在做打洞——因此 NAT 行为异常直接影响 ICE。
274	
275	### 7.1 Symmetric NAT → 打洞必然失败
276	
277	```
278	NAT-A (Cone NAT):  10.0.0.1:4000 → 1.2.3.4:60000 (发给谁都一样)
279	NAT-B (Symmetric): 10.0.0.2:5000 → 1.2.3.5:60001 (发给 A)
280	                                  → 1.2.3.5:60002 (发给 STUN 服务器)
281	                                  ↑ 端口不同！
282	```
283	
284	Alice 从 STUN 服务器得知 Bob 的公网地址是 `1.2.3.5:60002`，但 Bob 发给 Alice 时实际映射为 `60001`。Alice 发包到 `60002` → 被 Bob 的 NAT 丢弃 → 候选对 Failed。
285	
286	**ICE 的应对**：不预测端口，而是通过连接性检查实际"试"出来。如果所有尝试都失败 → 降级 TURN。
287	
288	### 7.2 NAT 映射超时
289	
290	NAT 映射有超时计时器（通常 30-120 秒）。在打洞期间如果两次重试间隔太长，映射可能过期。
291	
292	**ICE 的应对**：快速重传（RTO 初始 500ms，指数退避），确保在映射超时前完成。
293	
294	### 7.3 过时的中继地址
295	
296	候选收集完成后到连接性检查开始前，如果 Bob 的 NAT 映射已过期 → 端口变化 → 连接失败。
297	
298	**ICE 的应对**：候选收集紧接着连接性检查，时间窗口极小。
299	
300	---
301	
302	## 八、STUN 协议层的异常检测
303	
304	ICE 依赖 STUN 消息的格式校验来判断是否收到了有效的 STUN 响应：
305	
306	```
307	STUN 消息检测:
308	  1. 前 2 位是否为 0?         → 否 → 不是 STUN
309	  2. Magic Cookie = 0x2112A442? → 否 → 不是 STUN
310	  3. FINGERPRINT CRC32 校验?   → 否 → 不是 STUN
311	
312	  全部通过 → 是 STUN 消息
313	  任一失败 → 交给其他协议处理 (RTP/RTCP/etc.)
314	```
315	
316	这是一个**多路分解（demux）**机制：不是 STUN 的包不会被错误解释为 STUN 响应，而是路由给正确的协议处理器。
317	
318	---
319	
320	## 九、定时器与重传策略
321	
322	| 参数 | 默认值 | 作用 |
323	|------|--------|------|
324	| **Ta** | 50ms | 候选收集和检查的事务间隔 |
325	| **RTO** | 动态 (基于 RTT) | STUN 事务重传超时 |
326	| **Rc** | 7 | 最大重传次数 |
327	| **Allocation Lifetime** | 600s | TURN 分配生命周期 |
328	| **Permission Lifetime** | 300s | TURN 权限生命周期 |
329	
330	RTO 的计算基于 RTT 估计（类比 TCP），不是固定值：
331	
332	```
333	RTO = max(500ms, SRTT + 4 × RTTVAR)
334	其中:
335	  SRTT = 平滑后的往返时间
336	  RTTVAR = RTT 变化方差
337	```
338	
339	---
340	
341	## 十、异常处理设计原则总结
342	
343	| 原则 | 体现 |
344	|------|------|
345	| **分层兜底** | 事务重试 → 候选对 Failed → Checklist Failed → Session Failed → ICE Restart |
346	| **可恢复优先** | 认证失败重试、487 角色冲突自动切换，均不标记为 Failed |
347	| **安全防御** | 非对称地址检测防 IP 欺骗；ICMP 伪造警示防 DoS |
348	| **渐进降级** | host → srflx → relay，优先直连，失败后走中继 |
349	| **快速失败** | RTO 500ms 起步，避免长时间阻塞 |
350	| **逃生阀** | 本地策略可随时终止检查；ICE Restart 提供全局重置 |
351	| **无单点故障** | 每个组件、每个候选对独立检查，一个失败不影响其他 |
352	
353	---
354	
355	## 十一、与其他协议的对比
356	
357	| 维度 | ICE (RFC 8445) | 原始 UDP 打洞 | SIP |
358	|------|----------------|--------------|-----|
359	| 超时处理 | RTO 动态计算，最多 Rc 次重传 | 无标准，靠运气 | SIP 协议栈处理重传/故障转移 |
360	| 失败恢复 | 状态机驱动，自动降级 TURN | 无机制 | 依赖于底层传输 |
361	| 错误码 | 487 (Role Conflict) | 无 | 完整 SIP 响应码体系 |
362	| NAT 失败 | 检测到 Symmetric NAT → 降级 TURN | 打洞失败，无法恢复 | 不涉及 |
363	
364	---
365

# Complete Error Code Inventory: STUN, TURN, and ICE Protocols

All findings are from the files in `Z:\knowledge\knowledge_webrtc`. Every code is defined in the RFC source files (`raw/rfcs/`) and cross-referenced in the wiki pages (`wiki/`).

## ERROR-CODE Attribute Format (STUN/RFC 5389, Section 15.6)

**File:** `Z:\knowledge\knowledge_webrtc\raw\rfcs\rfc5389_完整中英对照.md`
**Lines:** 1442-1474

The ERROR-CODE attribute carries a numeric code in range **300-699**, split into:
- **Class** (3-bit, values 3-6): the hundreds digit
- **Number** (8-bit, values 0-99): the remainder (code mod 100)

Wire format is a 32-bit header followed by a variable-length UTF-8 Reason Phrase (max 128 characters).

---

## Client Default Handling Rules (RFC 5389, Section 7.3.4)

**File:** `Z:\knowledge\knowledge_webrtc\raw\rfcs\rfc5389_完整中英对照.md`
**Lines:** 754-771

| Range | Default Behavior |
|-------|-----------------|
| **300-399** | Client SHOULD consider transaction failed unless ALTERNATE-SERVER is used (Section 11) |
| **400-499** | Client declares the transaction failed (special exception: 420 provides UNKNOWN-ATTRIBUTES; ICE 487 triggers role switch) |
| **500-599** | Client MAY resend the request, with rate limiting |
| **Any other** | Client considers the transaction failed |

## Part 1: STUN Error Codes (RFC 5389)

**Defined at:** `Z:\knowledge\knowledge_webrtc\raw\rfcs\rfc5389_完整中英对照.md`, Section 15.6, Lines 1478-1501

### 300 -- Try Alternate (尝试备用服务器)

- **RFC:** RFC 5389
- **Meaning:** The server is redirecting the client to an alternate server. The response MUST include an ALTERNATE-SERVER attribute with the alternate server's address.
- **Security constraint:** This error response MUST only be sent if the request included a USERNAME and a valid MESSAGE-INTEGRITY; otherwise, error code 400 is suggested instead. The response MUST be protected with MESSAGE-INTEGRITY.
- **Client handling:** The client looks for the ALTERNATE-SERVER attribute. If found, it considers the current transaction failed and reattempts the request with the specified server, using the same transport protocol. To prevent redirection loops, the client MUST ignore the redirection if it has already tried that server within the last 5 minutes (Section 11, lines 1053-1061).

### 400 -- Bad Request (错误请求)

- **RFC:** RFC 5389
- **Meaning:** The request was malformed. The server may not be able to generate a valid MESSAGE-INTEGRITY for this error.
- **Client handling:** The client should NOT retry the request without modification. The client must not expect a valid MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute on this response.
- **Trigger scenarios:**
  - Message does not contain both MESSAGE-INTEGRITY and USERNAME attributes in a request using long-term credentials (line 894)
  - Message contains MESSAGE-INTEGRITY but is missing USERNAME, REALM, or NONCE (line 1005)
  - (TURN) ChannelBind: channel number is already bound to a different peer (line 1029)

### 401 -- Unauthorized (未授权)

- **RFC:** RFC 5389
- **Meaning:** The request did not contain the correct credentials to proceed. The response MUST include REALM and NONCE.
- **Client handling:** The client should retry the request with proper credentials. It MUST include USERNAME (determined from the REALM), REALM (copied from the error response), NONCE (copied from the error response), and MESSAGE-INTEGRITY (computed using the password). The client MUST NOT retry if it is not changing USERNAME, REALM, or password from the previous attempt (lines 1027-1029).
- **Trigger scenarios:**
  - The message does not contain MESSAGE-INTEGRITY (line 1002)
  - The USERNAME is not valid (line 1011)
  - The MESSAGE-INTEGRITY value does not match (line 1014)
  - (TURN) Authentication fails on Allocate, Refresh, CreatePermission, or ChannelBind requests

### 420 -- Unknown Attribute (未知属性)

- **RFC:** RFC 5389
- **Meaning:** The server received a STUN packet containing a comprehension-required attribute that it did not understand.
- **Client handling:** The client declares the transaction failed. The response contains an UNKNOWN-ATTRIBUTES attribute listing the 16-bit attribute types that were not understood (lines 1494-1495, 1535-1537, 636-638). The client can use this information to avoid including those attributes in a retry (if the usage permits retrying with modified attributes).

### 438 -- Stale Nonce (过期 Nonce)

- **RFC:** RFC 5389
- **Meaning:** The NONCE used by the client is no longer valid. The response MUST include a new NONCE and REALM.
- **Client handling:** The client MUST retry the request using the new NONCE supplied in the response. The retry MUST also include USERNAME, REALM, and MESSAGE-INTEGRITY (lines 1033-1035).
- **Note:** This is not a "subsequent request" in the authentication sense; the client forms it similarly to a response to 401 (line 976).

### 500 -- Server Error (服务器错误)

- **RFC:** RFC 5389
- **Meaning:** The server has suffered a temporary error.
- **Client handling:** The client may resend the request (with rate limiting), since 500-599 is retryable. The client should try again after a delay.

---

## Part 2: TURN Error Codes (RFC 5766)

**Defined at:** `Z:\knowledge\knowledge_webrtc\raw\rfcs\rfc5766_完整中英对照.md`, Section 4.5 (lines 617-639) and Section 15 (lines 1310-1332)

TURN defines all STUN error codes above, plus these six new codes:

### 403 -- Forbidden (禁止)

- **RFC:** RFC 5766
- **Meaning:** The request was valid and properly authenticated, but the server rejected it for policy reasons (e.g., the user is not authorized to use the TURN service, or the source IP is blacklisted).
- **Client handling:** This is a terminal error for that server. The client should NOT retry with the same server/credentials. It may need different credentials or a different server.

### 437 -- Allocation Mismatch (分配不匹配)

- **RFC:** RFC 5766
- **Meaning:** The client's server-reflexive address (IP address or port) does not match any existing allocation for this 5-tuple. This can happen after a NAT rebinding changes the client's external port.
- **Client handling:** The client needs to create a new allocation (Allocate request), since the old one is no longer reachable from its new address/port. This is a terminal error for the existing allocation but recoverable by creating a new one.
- **Trigger scenarios:**
  - Allocate: The 5-tuple already has a conflicting allocation (line 751)
  - Refresh: No existing allocation found for the 5-tuple (line 827)
  - CreatePermission: No existing allocation for the 5-tuple (line 900)
  - ChannelBind: No existing allocation for the 5-tuple (line 1026)

### 441 -- Wrong Credentials (凭证错误)

- **RFC:** RFC 5766
- **Meaning:** The credentials (username/password) used for authentication were incorrect. This is distinct from 401 -- 401 means "not authenticated yet" (no credentials, or bad nonce), while 441 means "the credentials you provided are wrong."
- **Client handling:** The client should NOT retry with the same credentials. It should obtain correct credentials and start a new transaction. This is a terminal error for the current credential set.

### 442 -- Unsupported Transport Protocol (不支持的传输协议)

- **RFC:** RFC 5766
- **Meaning:** The REQUESTED-TRANSPORT attribute is missing or does not specify a supported protocol (for this version of TURN, only UDP is required; TCP support is in RFC 6062).
- **Client handling:** The client should retry with a supported transport protocol (UDP), or switch to a server that supports the requested transport. This is a non-terminal error at the protocol-negotiation level.

### 486 -- Allocation Quota Reached (达到分配配额)

- **RFC:** RFC 5766
- **Meaning:** The client has reached the per-user limit on the number of simultaneous TURN allocations (line 691-693).
- **Client handling:** The client should release an unused allocation (by sending a Refresh with LIFETIME=0) before requesting a new one, or wait for an existing allocation to expire. Retrying without freeing an allocation will result in the same error.

### 508 -- Insufficient Capacity (容量不足)

- **RFC:** RFC 5766
- **Meaning:** The TURN server does not have sufficient resources (relay addresses, bandwidth, CPU, memory) to create a new allocation.
- **Client handling:** The client MAY retry after a delay, or try an alternate server (possibly via the 300/ALTERNATE-SERVER mechanism). Since 508 is in the 500-599 range, retry is permitted per RFC 5389 default rules.

---

## Part 3: ICE Error Codes (RFC 8445)

**Defined at:** `Z:\knowledge\knowledge_webrtc\raw\rfcs\rfc8445_完整中英对照.md`, Sections 16.2 (lines 2223-2230) and 20.2 (lines 2360-2364)

ICE does not define any new STUN methods or attributes beyond the ones for connectivity checks, but it defines one new error response code:

### 487 -- Role Conflict (角色冲突)

- **RFC:** RFC 8445
- **Meaning:** A Binding request was received from an ICE agent whose declared role (ICE-CONTROLLING or ICE-CONTROLLED) conflicts with the recipient's own role. This happens when both agents believe they are controlling (or both believe they are controlled), which can occur due to simultaneous candidate exchange or tiebreaker value collisions.
- **Trigger scenarios (Section 7.3.1.1, lines 1793-1799):**
  - Agent is in the **controlled** role and receives a Binding request with ICE-CONTROLLING attribute
  - Agent is in the **controlling** role and receives a Binding request with ICE-CONTROLLED attribute
  - Agent is in either role and receives a Binding request without either ICE-CONTROLLING or ICE-CONTROLLED attribute (the response MUST include the agent's own role attribute)
- **Client handling (Section 7.2.5.1, lines 1619-1631):**
  1. If the request included ICE-CONTROLLING, switch to the **controlled** role
  2. If the request included ICE-CONTROLLED, switch to the **controlling** role
  3. Recompute pair priorities (since priority depends on role)
  4. Add the candidate pair to the **triggered-check queue** and set its state to **Waiting**
  5. Change the tiebreaker value
  6. On the next connectivity check, the request will carry the new role attribute
- **Critical distinction:** 487 is NOT treated as a failure. The candidate pair is NOT set to Failed -- it is re-queued as Waiting. This makes 487 the only error code with an automatic recovery path built into ICE (documented at `Z:\knowledge\knowledge_webrtc\wiki\comparisons\comparison-ice-error-handling.md`, lines 170-189).

## 4. SDP Definitions

## 4. SDP 定义

---

This section defines a number of additional SDP parameters that are
used to describe a session.  All of these are defined as media-level
attributes.

本节定义了若干用于描述会话的附加 SDP 参数。所有这些都定义为媒体级属性。

---

### 4.1.  Profile Identification

### 4.1. Profile 标识

---

The AV profile defined in [4] is referred to as "AVP" in the context
of, e.g., the Session Description Protocol (SDP) [3].  The profile
specified in this document is referred to as "AVPF".

[4] 中定义的 AV profile 在会话描述协议 (SDP) [3] 等上下文中被称为 "AVP"。本文档中规定的 profile 被称为 "AVPF"。

---

Feedback information following the modified timing rules as specified
in this document MUST NOT be sent for a particular media session
unless the description for this session indicates the use of the
"AVPF" profile (exclusively or jointly with other AV profiles).

除非特定媒体会话的描述表明使用了 "AVPF" profile（单独使用或与其他 AV profile 联合使用），否则不得为该媒体会话发送遵循本文档规定的修改后定时规则的反馈信息。

---

### 4.2.  RTCP Feedback Capability Attribute

### 4.2. RTCP 反馈能力属性

---

A new payload format-specific SDP attribute is defined to indicate
the capability of using RTCP feedback as specified in this document:
"a=rtcp-fb".  The "rtcp-fb" attribute MUST only be used as an SDP
media attribute and MUST NOT be provided at the session level.  The
"rtcp-fb" attribute MUST only be used in media sessions for which the
"AVPF" is specified.

定义了一个新的有效载荷格式特定的 SDP 属性，用于指示使用本文档中规定的 RTCP 反馈的能力："a=rtcp-fb"。"rtcp-fb" 属性只能用作 SDP 媒体属性，不得在会话级提供。"rtcp-fb" 属性只能用于指定了 "AVPF" 的媒体会话。

---

The "rtcp-fb" attribute SHOULD be used to indicate which RTCP FB
messages MAY be used in this media session for the indicated payload
type.  A wildcard payload type ("*") MAY be used to indicate that the
RTCP feedback attribute applies to all payload types.  If several
types of feedback are supported and/or the same feedback shall be
specified for a subset of the payload types, several "a=rtcp-fb"
lines MUST be used.

"rtcp-fb" 属性应用于指示此媒体会话中可以针对所指示的有效载荷类型使用哪些 RTCP FB 消息。可以使用通配符有效载荷类型（"*"）来指示 RTCP 反馈属性适用于所有有效载荷类型。如果支持多种类型的反馈和/或需要为有效载荷类型的子集指定相同的反馈，则必须使用多个 "a=rtcp-fb" 行。

---

If no "rtcp-fb" attribute is specified, the RTP receivers MAY send
feedback using other suitable RTCP feedback packets as defined for
the respective media type.  The RTP receivers MUST NOT rely on the
RTP senders reacting to any of the FB messages.  The RTP sender MAY
choose to ignore some feedback messages.

如果没有指定 "rtcp-fb" 属性，RTP 接收者可以使用为相应媒体类型定义的其他合适的 RTCP 反馈数据包发送反馈。RTP 接收者不得依赖 RTP 发送者对任何 FB 消息做出反应。RTP 发送者可以选择忽略某些反馈消息。

---

If one or more "rtcp-fb" attributes are present in a media session
description, the RTCP receivers for the media session(s) containing
the "rtcp-fb"

o  MUST ignore all "rtcp-fb" attributes of which they do not fully
   understand the semantics (i.e., where they do not understand the
   meaning of all values in the "a=rtcp-fb" line);

o  SHOULD provide feedback information as specified in this document
   using any of the RTCP feedback packets as specified in one of the
   "rtcp-fb" attributes for this media session; and

o  MUST NOT use other FB messages than those listed in one of the
   "rtcp-fb" attribute lines.

如果媒体会话描述中存在一个或多个 "rtcp-fb" 属性，则包含 "rtcp-fb" 的媒体会话的 RTCP 接收者：

o  必须忽略所有其不完全理解语义的 "rtcp-fb" 属性（即不理解 "a=rtcp-fb" 行中所有值的含义）；

o  应使用此媒体会话的某个 "rtcp-fb" 属性中指定的任何 RTCP 反馈数据包，按照本文档的规定提供反馈信息；并且

o  不得使用 "rtcp-fb" 属性行中列出的 FB 消息之外的 FB 消息。

---

When used in conjunction with the offer/answer model [8], the offerer
MAY present a set of these AVPF attributes to its peer.  The answerer
MUST remove all attributes it does not understand as well as those it
does not support in general or does not wish to use in this
particular media session.  The answerer MUST NOT add feedback
parameters to the media description and MUST NOT alter values of such
parameters.  The answer is binding for the media session, and both
offerer and answerer MUST only use feedback mechanisms negotiated in
this way.  Both offerer and answerer MAY independently decide to send
RTCP FB messages of only a subset of the negotiated feedback
mechanisms, but they SHOULD react properly to all types of the
negotiated FB messages when received.

当与 offer/answer 模型 [8] 结合使用时，offer 方可以向其对等方呈现一组这些 AVPF 属性。answer 方必须删除其不理解的所有属性，以及其通常不支持或在此特定媒体会话中不希望使用的属性。answer 方不得向媒体描述添加反馈参数，也不得更改此类参数的值。answer 对媒体会话具有约束力，offer 方和 answer 方都必须仅使用通过这种方式协商的反馈机制。offer 方和 answer 方都可以独立决定仅发送协商的反馈机制的子集中的 RTCP FB 消息，但当收到协商的 FB 消息时，它们应对所有类型的协商 FB 消息做出适当的反应。

---

RTP senders MUST be prepared to receive any kind of RTCP FB messages
and MUST silently discard all those RTCP FB messages that they do not
understand.

RTP 发送者必须准备好接收任何类型的 RTCP FB 消息，并且必须静默丢弃所有其不理解的 RTCP FB 消息。

types and optional parameters are all case sensitive):

(In the following ABNF, fmt, SP, and CRLF are used as defined in
[3].)

（在以下 ABNF 中，fmt、SP 和 CRLF 按照 [3] 中的定义使用。）
